clips.title: The story
paras: At Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh, Rudra Amberstill faces the loss of mountain rams to Vagash. With Ironforge's forces spread thin, the breeders need passing fighters to defend their herd.

Vagash has taken two mountain rams from Amberstill Ranch. The ranch supplies the Bronzebeard dwarves with riding and working beasts, and the herd matters to Dun Morogh's rustic economy. The savage predator prowls the crags above the ranch, hunting local livestock.

Ironforge's forces are spread thin across the realm, supporting the Alliance on distant frontiers. With no military patrol on the ridgelines, Rudra Amberstill asks independent fighters to hunt Vagash and bring back one of the beast's deadly fangs as proof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We heard the cries in the middle of the night. Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams. That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood. With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.
Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him. Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you. Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Vagash still terrorizes the herd! Please help us by killing the wretched beast.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very well done! Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news. To kill Vagash is no easy task. I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
